examples.en: Yet, not all emoji are properly used on social media.
examples.zh: 然而，并不是所有表情符号都能被恰当地运用在社交媒体上。

examples.en: Emoji can help communication feel friendlier, and even a serious note can be softened with an encouraging smile.
examples.zh: 表情符号能让交流感觉更友好，甚至一个严肃的便条也能因为一个鼓励的微笑而变得柔和起来。

examples.en: However, most young netizens consider this emoji as "Laugh to tears" or simply "LOL", which means "Laugh out loud".
examples.zh: 然而，大多数年轻网民认为这个表情符号是“笑到流泪”或只是“LOL”，意思是“大笑”。
